public_rationale: NVIDIA's quarterly filing for the period ended July 26, 2026 disclosed agreed payment terms of 90 days to one year for certain investment-grade customers [e1]. Those terms do not establish that customers missed payment deadlines [e1]. The filing does not establish material payment failures or an earnings effect attributable to such failures, leaving the conditional forecast unresolved [e1].
limitations: The filing does not provide a complete customer-level delinquency and collection history.
The evidence does not establish whether the payment-failure condition occurred by October 28, 2026.
The relevant earnings report depends on when a qualifying payment failure occurs.
The claim specifies no earnings metric, accounting basis or fixed calendar deadline.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If NVIDIA's customers fail to pay reliably, NVIDIA's earnings will look bad.
conditions: NVIDIA's customers fail to pay reliably

statement.excerpt: Any issues with NVIDIA’s customers’ ability to pay: If NVIDIA’s customers don’t reliably pay it, things will look bad come earnings season.
statement.document_title: The Subprime AI Crisis Is Here

from_speaker: If NVIDIA’s customers don’t reliably pay it
things will look bad come earnings season
our_interpretation: The antecedent means material customer payment failures or persistent delinquency against agreed payment terms. Larger receivables or longer agreed terms alone do not establish it.
The ordinary financial reading of the consequence is a material adverse earnings effect from those payment problems, such as credit-loss charges or lost sales attributable to nonpayment.
'Come earnings season' means the earnings report reflecting the payment failures. Without a dated trigger, it supplies no fixed calendar deadline.
The claim does not identify an accounting basis or a particular earnings measure; these must not be silently supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Verified material customer payment failures are followed by an earnings report documenting a material adverse effect attributable to those failures.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After verified material payment failures, the relevant completed reporting and collection cycle establishes that they caused no material adverse earnings effect.

evidence.explanation: The surrounding disclosure permits longer agreed payment terms for certain investment-grade customers and attributes part of receivables growth to those terms. That establishes financing and collection timing, but does not establish customers failing to pay when due.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Dated records establishing material customer payment failures, followed by the relevant earnings report showing a material adverse effect attributable to them. Alternatively, completed reporting and collection records must conclusively establish that those failures caused no material adverse earnings effect.
